name: Archisketch – 3D Interior Design Solution
author: Archisketch Team

sections.description:
Archisketch is a 3D interior CRM using AR/VR, 2D/3D floor plans, and render images to attract visitors and support online businesses.

How to use

  1. Click Add Plugins in the WordPress administrator, and enter Archisketch in the search bar to install Archisketch plugin.
  2. After installing the plugin, enter the Plugin key in the plugin details page to activate it.
    • You can check the Plugin key by entering the [connect] page in the Archisketch administrator page.
    • Archisketch administrator is a corporate service. If you wish to use the administrator, please contact Archisketch.Inc.

External services

This plugin allows enterprise users to integrate the Archisketch 3D Interior Platform into their websites.
By doing so, website visitors can access a customized 3D interior design platform to explore 3D interiors and furniture content set up by the enterprise users.

The Archisketch plugin provides APIs with the following functions to seamlessly synchronize user data between the website (or service) and the Archisketch platform:
– For existing members: When logged into the website, users are automatically signed into the Archisketch platform integrated into the site.
– For new members: When a new user signs up, their information is automatically synced with Archisketch.

This plugin connects to the Archisketch API and resources to provide its core functionalities. Below are the details of the external services used:

  1. Archisketch API

    • Domain: https://api.archisketch.com
    • Purpose:
      • Synchronize user data between the WordPress website and the Archisketch platform.
      • Manage API requests such as verifying integration status and removing data connections.
    • Data Transmitted:
      • User identifier (UUID)
      • Encrypted data for verification (X-CONNECT-CHECK header)

    Endpoints Used:

    • https://api.archisketch.com/v1/connect/plugins?identifier={UUID}
    • https://api.archisketch.com/v1/connect/channels/{identifier}?type=wordpress

  2. Archisketch Resources

    • Domain: https://resources.archisketch.com
    • Purpose:
      • Load the JavaScript files required for the Archisketch plugin’s frontend functionality.
    • Resources Loaded:
      • https://resources.archisketch.com/connect/wordpress-plugin.min.js

This service is provided by Archisketch Inc.
By using this plugin, user data is transmitted securely to Archisketch servers to enable integration and synchronization functionalities.
For more details, refer to Archisketch’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
